title: Duplication option works poorly; task limit
body: Most of the time duplication doesn’t work at all, I have to go back to task settings over and over again and reclick it so that after around 5 times of doing it, it would finally add itself. Also, I can’t add more than 23 tasks, which is uncomfortable for me.

title: Cool
body:
Great app ! 2 things missing for me:
1. Make checkboxes more accesible from right thumb (i am right handed do it would be easier to manage one-handed)
2. Make them a little more satisfactory to tap. It would be great to have this little motivation also :D

Otherwise great work.
